flow.שם תחנה: chart-records, chart-latest, chart-storms, chart-sewage, chart-network, chart-long, table-decades, kpi:stations, kpi:active, insight:record, insight:latest, insight:network
flow.זמן מדידת ספיקה: chart-peaks, chart-season, chart-heat, chart-storms, chart-flow, chart-network, chart-long, chart-latest, kpi:span, kpi:active, insight:season, insight:storm, insight:wettest, insight:sewage — hydrological year (Oct-Sep) is derived from the timestamp
flow.ספיקה (מ''ק/שנייה): chart-records, chart-peaks, chart-latest, chart-season, chart-storms, chart-flow, table-decades, kpi:record, insight:record, insight:latest, insight:wettest
flow.סוג זרימה: chart-flow, chart-sewage, chart-heat, insight:sewage, insight:sewage_stations — known codes גאות/תקין/ביוב, anything else folded into אחר; normal flow reading zero at both ends is shown as a dry riverbed
flow.סוג נתון: chart-records, table-decades, insight:recon, insight:record — measured vs reconstructed
flow._resource_name: skip: file name of each period CSV; the timestamp already carries the period
flow.זיהוי תחנה: skip: identifier, 1:1 with station name (not fetched)
flow.שם תחנה באנגלית: skip: English duplicate of the station name (not fetched)
flow.שנה הידרולוגית: skip: redundant, derived from the timestamp (not fetched)
flow.רום המים (מ'): skip: stage height in each station's local gauge datum, not comparable across stations; 7% empty (not fetched)
flow.סוג רשומה: chart-flow, chart-sewage, insight:sewage, insight:sewage_stations — segment end/start markers: the interval after a segment end is a data gap and is not counted as flow time
